entities.summary: Anthony Harris is an American former professional football player who was a safety in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Cavaliers, and was signed by the Minnesota Vikings of the National Football League (NFL) as an undrafted free agent in 2015. He played his first six seasons with Minnesota, and was the NFL interceptions co-leader in 2019.
